references.text: The prophecy in Isaiah that the Messianic age will bring healing, including sight to the blind, which is fulfilled in Jesus' healing of Bartimaeus.
Another event where Jesus heals a blind man, demonstrating his power and mercy, parallel to the healing of Bartimaeus.
A similar account of Jesus healing two blind men near Jericho, showing Jesus' ability and willingness to heal.
Luke's version of the event with Bartimaeus, offering a parallel perspective on the story and emphasizing Jesus' compassion.
